description.narrative: Several thematic areas (democratic culture/peace, gender equality and Health/SRHR/family planning) are combined by training rights holders to know and advocate for their rights, by strengthening women’s economic power and by strengthening CSOs to be functional, democratic and actively advocate for human rights. Expected results: -children accept the participation of all in decision-making, are able to identify challenges in their environment and approach duty-bearers for advocacy, together with PTAs -men/boys are more accepting of gender equality, women have more access to the inheritance of land/the means of production, there is a reduction in GBV, an increase in the female literacy rate, more gender parity in positions of responsibility in institutions, organizations and communities and better distribution of roles in families and households. -women and girls have better access to sexual and reproductive health care, -women and girls no longer have unwanted and early pregnancies.
